blocks.text: The year 2026 is proving to be Andrea Brillantes’ milestone year after winning the Best Acting Performance award for her new movie “Laya” at the Women and the World International Film Festival (WWIFF). The London-based competition celebrates women’s voices, creativity, resilience, and leadership in cinema, culture, and global dialogue — often highlighting stories related to women in conflict zones, peace-building, and human rights. READ: Andrea Brillantes, JC Santos confront old wounds in ‘Laya’ trailer “Laya” first premiered at the WWIFF last November 7, which Brillantes personally attended.
